title: PATCH /tournaments/:id/incidents/:iid request
description: An incident amended: its kind, its note, or both; a field left out stays as it is. Who may: whoever may log one (owner, editor or arbiter), and only a kind this phone's level may log - for the new kind and for the old one. Answered with incident-response.schema.json (200). Refusals (error.schema.json): 404 not_found, 422 unknown_kind / kind_not_allowed / note_too_long, 409 archived / handed_off.
